title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.14905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI has long assisted scientific research, but the rapid advance of LLMs and agentic scaffolds is reshaping the landscape; a single system can now carry whole-stage research from an initial hypothesis all the way to final published paper, which is a paradigm now referred to as AutoResearch. Existing evaluations reveal little about how these agents operate or where they break down. Tasks are narrowly-scoped, evaluation measures performance but not process, and failure diagnoses lack systematic coverage or artifact-level visibility. To address this gap, we introduce AutoResearchEval, featuring 100 tasks grounded in published frontier science across 7 scientific domains and the full research lifecycle, including ideation, retrieval, execution, analysis, writing, and review. translated_title: 智能体如何在自动研究上失败：针对100项真实前沿研究任务的端到端诊断评估
translated_abstract: 摘要：人工智能长期以来一直辅助科学研究，但大语言模型和智能体框架的快速发展正在重塑这一格局；单个系统现在可以完成从初始假设到最终发表论文的整个研究阶段，这种范式现在被称为自动研究（AutoResearch）。现有评估很少揭示这些智能体如何运作或在哪里失败。任务范围狭窄，评估衡量性能而非过程，失败诊断缺乏系统性覆盖或工件级可见性。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了AutoResearchEval，包含100项基于已发表前沿科学的任务，涵盖7个科学领域和完整研究生命周期，包括构思、检索、执行、分析、写作和评审。评估8种框架-模型组合，产生800条自动研究智能体轨迹，并带有过程级标注。我们将这些见解组织成自动研究失败分类法（AutoResearch Failure Taxonomy）。
tldr: 本文提出了AutoResearchEval基准，通过100项真实前沿研究任务和800条过程级标注轨迹，系统性地诊断了自动研究智能体在完整研究生命周期中的失败模式，并构建了首个自动研究失败分类法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AutoResearchEval, a benchmark with 100 real-world frontier research tasks and 800 process-level annotated trajectories, systematically diagnosing failure modes of AutoResearch agents across the full research lifecycle and establishing the first AutoResearch Failure Taxonomy.
